name: kql-not-unsatisfiable-block
description: A NOT block whose clauses are conjunctive but disconnected: one sub-pattern matches, another matches nothing. The block as a whole has no solution, so it must exclude nothing — an engine that reads the matching sub-pattern's rows as exclusions drops rows the query asked for.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Node"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Graph node" } } CONCEPT ?u { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Tag"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Never instantiated" } } CONCEPT ?p { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "links_to"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Directed edge" } } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?d { {type: "Node", name: "D"} } CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Node", name: "C"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("links_to", ?d) } } CONCEPT ?b { {type: "Node", name: "B"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("links_to", ?c) } } CONCEPT ?a { {type: "Node", name: "A"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("links_to", ?b) } } CONCEPT ?x { {type: "Node", name: "X"} } }

cases.name: a satisfiable NOT block excludes the rows it matches
a NOT block with an unmatchable disconnected clause excludes nothing
